subject: IEG status: 80% noise result reproduced, meta-step cost is the trade-off
body:
Dmitri, Bruno,

Status. IEG repro is done on CIFAR100 with wrn28-10 across 20/40/80% uniform noise - at 80% noise we hold within 1.2 pts of the released accuracy, which is the number that makes people sit up. Also confirmed the augmentation note from the release: switching AutoAugment to RandAugment is on par, within noise, so we'll standardize on RandAugment for the platform since it's simpler to serve. Asymmetric-noise CIFAR10 configs are queued on Chiara's harness this week - the noise-injection module made spinning those up trivial.

The trade-off for the memo: IEG's meta-step roughly doubles training cost versus standard training. Early FSR runs recover most of the benefit at low noise for a fraction of the overhead, but degrade faster at 80%. So the likely recommendation shape is tiered: FSR as the default noise-robust option, IEG reserved for known-bad label sources. Bilal is filling in the cost/accuracy frontier now.

On track for July 13.

Tereza
